_comment: The single maintained source for every user-facing string in data/index.html and data/app.js. tools/build_strings.py flattens this into data/strings.js at build time; nothing reads this file at run time, and keys beginning with _ are not emitted. Placeholders are named, as in {network}. Keys are semantic and grouped by feature, never named after an element. Messages name Serial2WiFi where the reader could otherwise take 'the device' to mean the phone or computer they are reading on. In every rendered state one element owns each fact, status, instruction and action: a title names the state, supporting text adds a cause, consequence, useful detail or next step, and a button names the action. Do not shorten a message to the point where it needs the element above it to be understood.

app.connectionLost: Lost the connection to Serial2WiFi. Retrying…

signOut.title: Sign out and discard unsaved changes?

editor.lanNoticeUnnamed: Connecting moves Serial2WiFi to this network. This phone or computer may lose contact with it. If that happens, join the setup network shown on the display and reopen this page for the result.

trial.couldNotConnect: Couldn't connect to {network}. Check the router.

handoff.nextUnnamed: You are reading this over the setup network, which Serial2WiFi switches off about 10 minutes after it connects. Move this phone or computer to {network} to keep using that address.

forget.detailLan: Serial2WiFi removes {network} and its password, then leaves this network, so this page loses its connection. To reach it again, join the setup network shown on the display.

tcp.title: TCP
tcp._runtime: The chip beside the TCP heading on Setup, above the fields being edited. 'Current' is what separates what is running from what is typed; the coloured dot only reinforces it.

device.title: Device
device.screenSaverHelp: Leave blank to keep the display on.

_bridge: One line: a state word and a detail. The detail carries the port, the endpoint, the cause or the action the state word does not, never a second wording of it.

bridge.stale: The last reading may be out of date.

wifi.notFound: The saved network is out of range or not broadcasting. Serial2WiFi keeps looking.
